payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased using negative feedback from utterances with negative responses.

claims.text: Confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased by leveraging utterances with negative system responses, specifically when these domains are among the top predictions.
The approach formulates a loss function that demotes the confidences of negative ground-truth domains only when they are the highest ranked, preventing overwhelming influence on the model.
This method helps reduce prediction errors and improves model performance in domain classification tasks.
